name: Dariusz Afolabi-Szczepański
description: A former Tier 4 compliance auditor for Helix-Vanta Corponation who, in 2219, livestreamed his own termination meeting via unauthorized BCI broadcast — including seventeen minutes of unfiltered executive decision-making about the Gray Zone-district water filtration cuts — to an audience that swelled to 4.2 million concurrent feeds before the signal was killed. Dariusz, born to a Polish-Nigerian family in the Tier 2 Bridgewater stack, had no intention of becoming famous; he was simply recording for personal legal protection. The broadcast, now known as 'The Szczepański Leak' or simply 'The Seventeen,' became the most replayed neural-feed event of the decade, not just for its content but for the raw, unperformed terror in his emotional signal — something no produced content could fake.
cultural_impact: The Seventeen permanently altered how GLMZ residents interpret 'authentic' neural content — any feed that feels too composed is now derisively called 'Helix-clean,' while raw, unfiltered emotional broadcasting surged as both art form and political tool. Dariusz himself lives somewhere in the Gray Zone under rotating identities, occasionally surfacing to verify he's still alive, which itself becomes a news event.
key_figures: Councilor Mette Jiang-Osei (Helix-Vanta exec in the recording)
Parveen Solís-Nakamura (the archivist who mirrored the feed before deletion)
locations: The Seventeen Archive — a ghost-market data node in the Gray Zone's Cinder Quarter
Helix-Vanta Regional HQ, Tier 4 North Lakeface
story_hooks: A player character receives a fragmented neural-ping from an anonymous source — the emotional signature matches Dariusz's publicly archived fear-state from The Seventeen, suggesting he's trying to leak something new but can't surface safely.

Helix-Vanta hires the crew to quietly locate and 'resolve' the Szczepański situation before a corponation tribunal reviews the water filtration case — framed as a simple locate-and-extract, with the word 'extract' doing a lot of heavy lifting.

A the Gray Zone art collective wants to stage a live reenactment of The Seventeen using a synthetic who can perfectly replicate Dariusz's emotional broadcast signature — but the real Dariusz has sent word through back channels that he considers this a death sentence for him, and he wants it stopped.
platform: Unauthorized BCI broadcast (originally); archived across Underworld mirror nodes
follower_count: 11.3 million passive archive followers; no active feed
controversy: The Seventeen — a 17-minute unauthorized live neural-feed of a Helix-Vanta boardroom discussion revealing deliberate the Gray Zone water filtration rollbacks, broadcast during his own termination meeting in 2219; Helix-Vanta disputes the recording's authenticity while simultaneously suing for its removal
related_entities: Palladian Construction MagRail Spur MRS-17 Elevated Micro-Transit Chassis
